frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: You have proven yourself, brave traveller. The rock spirit within you is undeniable. The Thunderstone awakens, and with it, the heart of Ampliforia beats once more!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We did it, Gnork! Ampliforia's rock spirit is alive again!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: You've got the true spirit of a rock legend.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: It's rolling to the side... revealing something.

frames.heading: You received a Celestial Amp!
frames.body: In the rugged world of Ampliforia, the Celestial Amp is a legendary artifact of immense sonic power. Forged from molten metals and infused with the essence of thunderous rock anthems, it amplifies riffs with the planet's raw, untamed energy. This mighty amplifier transforms simple tunes into epic rock symphonies, connecting the music to the very heart of Ampliforia's hardcore soul.

frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: Take the celestial amp, traveller. It will aid you in your quest to restore harmony across the stars. Remember the power of rock that brought us together.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Lightningfist. Thank you, Gnork. And thank you, Goliaths. Together, we've made Ampliforia rock again. Now, it's time to bring this spirit to the next world - Funkopolis!
